title: Dexter
hook: How does Dexter end? Debra's stroke, the burial at sea, and the lumberjack reveal in the original Season 8 finale, explained.

sections.heading: Debra's fatal turn
sections.body: The original 2013 finale, "Remember the Monsters?", sets its tragedy in motion when Debra Morgan is shot by Oliver Saxon and rushed to the hospital. Doctors are at first optimistic about her recovery, and it looks as if she will pull through. During surgery, however, a blood clot triggers a stroke that leaves Debra in a persistent vegetative state with no hope of waking. The reversal is the gut-punch the finale turns on: the one person Dexter loves most is reduced to a body on life support, and the consequence of his life finally lands on the sister who covered for him.

sections.heading: Hannah and Harrison run
sections.body: While Debra fades, Dexter's plan to flee to Argentina with Hannah McKay and his son Harrison comes apart and then partly succeeds. Hannah and Harrison board a bus toward Jacksonville, but private detective Jacob Elway tries to grab Hannah at a Daytona bus stop. She injects him with one of Dexter's tranquilizers and slips away with the boy. Hannah and Harrison make it onto a flight to Argentina, escaping the country safely. Over the phone Dexter tells them he loves them, then disconnects the call, severing himself from the family he had hoped to start a new life with.

sections.heading: Burial at sea in the hurricane
sections.body: Choosing not to leave Debra in a vegetative state, Dexter goes to the hospital and disconnects her life support himself. He then carries her body out on his boat, the Slice of Life, into the open ocean as Hurricane Laura bears down on Miami. After committing his sister to the water, Dexter deliberately steers the boat into the heart of the storm. The act reads as a suicide: the man who narrated eight seasons appears to drive himself to his death rather than carry on after destroying everyone close to him, ending the Bay Harbor Butcher in the sea.

sections.heading: The lumberjack reveal
sections.body: The Coast Guard later recovers wreckage from Dexter's boat with no survivors, and the world is told he is dead. The finale's closing twist undercuts that: Dexter is alive, living under an assumed identity as a lumberjack in a remote town in Oregon. The series ends on him sitting alone in his small house, turning to stare directly into the camera. He has survived but stripped himself of everyone and everything, a self-imposed exile rather than death or justice, a final image that left many viewers cold about how the killer's story closed.

final_image: Dexter, now a bearded lumberjack alone in an Oregon cabin, lifts his head and stares directly into the camera.

lingering_questions.q: Does Dexter die in the Season 8 finale?
lingering_questions.a: No. He steers his boat into Hurricane Laura and the Coast Guard finds only wreckage, but the final scene reveals he survived and is living in hiding as a lumberjack in Oregon.

lingering_questions.q: What happens to Debra and to Harrison?
lingering_questions.a: Debra suffers a stroke after surgery and is left in a persistent vegetative state; Dexter takes her off life support and buries her at sea. Harrison escapes to Argentina with Hannah McKay.
